experiments.claim_being_tested: Career coaches have a recurring costly workflow researching automation exposure for clients that this product can address
experiments.method: Recruit 12 independent career-transition coaches (8 US, 4 Canada) via warm referrals and opt-in communities. 30-min interviews with consistent script: workflow, manual research time, tools, trust concerns, buyer process, WTP. No pitch in first 20 minutes. Use static /sample-report after discovery with pseudonymous data and consented notes.
experiments.success_threshold: >=8/12 coaches report recurring costly workflow researching automation exposure
experiments.decision_rule: >=8/12 report costly workflow AND >=6/12 qualify for pilot -> proceed to EXP-005; <4/12 -> recycle ICP before pilot
experiments.risk_check: no cold outreach, no pitch in first 20 minutes, no free live reports, pseudonymous data only, exclude employee-selection/school-placement/HR-decision uses
experiments.instrumentation: structured interview script, consented notes, PostHog coach_pilot_interest_submitted event
experiments.falsification_potential: high — if coaches do not report a recurring costly workflow, the ICP is wrong
experiments.blocking_potential: blocks EXP-005 if <3/12 qualify for pilot

experiments.claim_being_tested: The static sample report artifact demonstrates sufficient value for coaches to express willingness to pay
experiments.method: After discovery questions in EXP-001, show the existing /sample-report page with pseudonymous data. Capture reactions: clarity, trust, perceived value, concerns. No live report generation, no free reports, no testimonials in exchange for free reports.
experiments.success_threshold: >=6/12 coaches say the artifact would save time
experiments.decision_rule: >=6/12 see value -> proceed to EXP-005; 0/12 -> redesign artifact or positioning
experiments.risk_check: no live report generation, no free reports, no testimonials in exchange for free reports
experiments.instrumentation: reaction capture in consented notes, PostHog coach_sample_viewed event
experiments.falsification_potential: high — if zero coaches see value, artifact needs redesign

experiments.claim_being_tested: O*NET government data sourcing is a perceived differentiator that coaches value over generic AI analysis
experiments.method: A/B test O*NET source citation emphasis vs generic AI analysis emphasis in outreach. 10 coaches per variant. Do not run until coach motion clears paid-pilot gate.
experiments.success_threshold: O*NET variant response rate > generic variant by >10%
experiments.failure_threshold: No difference or generic variant outperforms O*NET variant
experiments.decision_rule: A > B by >10% -> O*NET grounding is a differentiator; no difference or B > A -> product needs a different value prop
experiments.risk_check: deferred until coach motion clears paid-pilot gate; no underpowered A/B tests
experiments.instrumentation: response and acceptance rate tracking per variant
experiments.falsification_potential: medium — if no difference, O*NET grounding may not be a perceived differentiator
experiments.blocking_potential: does not block pilot; informs messaging strategy

experiments.claim_being_tested: Organic SEO traffic can acquire users at meaningful scale for the automation-risk landing pages
experiments.method: Submit sitemap to Google Search Console. Track organic impressions and clicks for /automation-risk/:slug pages over 30 days. Deferred until coach motion clears paid-pilot gate.
experiments.success_threshold: >100 organic impressions and >10 organic clicks in 30 days
experiments.decision_rule: >100 impressions and >10 clicks -> SEO is a viable channel; 0 impressions -> indexing/authority issue to resolve
experiments.risk_check: deferred until coach motion clears paid-pilot gate
experiments.instrumentation: Google Search Console impressions, clicks, CTR, query data
experiments.falsification_potential: low — 0 impressions indicates indexing issue, not necessarily invalid hypothesis
experiments.blocking_potential: does not block pilot; informs distribution strategy

experiments.claim_being_tested: Career coaches will pay $49 for a 5-report credit pack without a free trial
experiments.method: Offer 8 qualified coaches from EXP-001 a 30-day, $49, 5-credit pilot. No free reports for testimonials. Require human-review acknowledgement and pseudonymous client labels. Prohibit employment decisions and predictive claims. Record: checkout, report completion, repeat use, feedback, permission (separately).
experiments.decision_rule: >=3/8 pay AND >=2/8 complete human-reviewed uses -> proceed to EXP-006; <2/8 pay -> recycle positioning/ICP/pricing
experiments.risk_check: require human-review acknowledgement, pseudonymous client labels, no employment decisions, no predictive claims, testimonials require explicit approval after genuine use
experiments.instrumentation: Stripe test-mode checkout, credit ledger transactions, PostHog coach_checkout_started/completed events
experiments.falsification_potential: high — if <2/8 pay, WTP hypothesis is weakened

experiments.claim_being_tested: Career coaches will pay $149/mo for Coach Pro subscription after pilot validates the $49 credit pack
experiments.method: Sequential price test: offer $149/mo to next 6 qualified coaches. If none convert, offer $99/mo to following 6. No underpowered A/B tests — sequential only. Deferred until subscription checkout mechanics proven via EXP-005.
experiments.decision_rule: >=1/6 at $149 -> proceed at $149; 0/6 at $149 AND >=2/6 at $99 -> proceed at $99; 0/6 at both -> recycle
experiments.risk_check: deferred until subscription checkout mechanics proven via EXP-005; no underpowered A/B tests — sequential only
experiments.instrumentation: Stripe checkout conversion tracking per price point
experiments.falsification_potential: high — if 0/12 convert at both prices, pricing or product gap
experiments.blocking_potential: does not block pilot; informs subscription pricing
